class Bar(Schema):

print("  Result:", result)

print("  PASSED")

# Test 4: Many=True with invalid type

class FooMany(Schema):
    bars = fields.Nested(Bar, many=True)

print("  Result:", result)

print("  PASSED")

print("  Result:", result)
print("  PASSED")

        pass

class FooOptional(Schema):

print("  PASSED")

from marshmallow import Schema, fields, validates, ValidationError


# Test case 1: Original issue - nested schema with invalid data
class Bar(Schema):
    value = fields.String()

    @validates('value')
    def validate_value(self, value):
        pass


class Foo(Schema):
    bar = fields.Nested(Bar)


sch = Foo()
errors = sch.validate({'bar': 'invalid'})
print("Test 1 (nested invalid data):", errors)


# Test case 2: Nested schema with valid data
errors = sch.validate({'bar': {'value': 'hello'}})
print("Test 2 (nested valid data):", errors)


# Test case 3: Nested schema with validation error in field
class BarWithValidation(Schema):
    value = fields.String()

    @validates('value')
    def validate_value(self, value):
        if value == 'bad':
            raise ValidationError('Value cannot be bad')


class FooWithValidation(Schema):
    bar = fields.Nested(BarWithValidation)


sch2 = FooWithValidation()
errors = sch2.validate({'bar': {'value': 'bad'}})
print("Test 3 (validation error in nested field):", errors)


# Test case 4: Many nested with invalid data
class FooMany(Schema):
    bars = fields.Nested(Bar, many=True)


sch3 = FooMany()
errors = sch3.validate({'bars': 'invalid'})
print("Test 4 (many nested invalid data):", errors)


# Test case 5: Many nested with valid data
errors = sch3.validate({'bars': [{'value': 'hello'}]})
print("Test 5 (many nested valid data):", errors)


# Test case 6: Top-level schema with @validates and invalid input
class TopLevel(Schema):

    @validates('value')

        pass


sch4 = TopLevel()
errors = sch4.validate('invalid')
print("Test 6 (top-level invalid input):", errors)


# Test case 7: Top-level schema with @validates and valid input
errors = sch4.validate({'value': 'hello'})
print("Test 7 (top-level valid input):", errors)


print("\nAll tests passed!")

from marshmallow import Schema, fields, validates


class Bar(Schema):
    value = fields.String()

    @validates('value')
    def validate_value(self, value):
        if value == 'invalid':
            raise ValueError("Value cannot be 'invalid'")


class Foo(Schema):
    bar = fields.Nested(Bar)


# Test 1: Original bug case - invalid type for nested field

# Test 2: Valid nested data

print("  Result:", result)
assert result == {}
print("  PASSED")

# Test 3: Nested validation error (value validation fails)
print("Test 3: Nested validation error")
result = sch.validate({'bar': {'value': 'invalid'}})
print("  Result:", result)
assert 'bar' in result
print("  PASSED")

# Test 4: Many=True with invalid type
print("Test 4: Many=True with invalid type")
class FooMany(Schema):
    bars = fields.Nested(Bar, many=True)

sch_many = FooMany()
result = sch_many.validate({'bars': 'invalid'})
print("  Result:", result)
assert 'bars' in result
print("  PASSED")

# Test 5: Empty data

print("  Result:", result)
print("  PASSED")

    bar = fields.Nested(BarOptional, allow_none=True)

print("  Result:", result)
print("  PASSED")

print("\nAll tests passed!")
